mil7.8.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, khettassa tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni tīṇi angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.8.4:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sucaritavattapaṭivatta-mātikāsampannena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.8.4:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja khettassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.4:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja khettaṃ mariyādāsampannaṃ hoti, tāya ca mariyādāya udakaṃ rakkhitvā dhaññaṃ paripācenti,
mil7.8.4:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena sīla-hiri-mariyādāsampannena bhavitabbaṃ, tāya ca sīla-hiri-mariyādāya sāmaññaṃ rakkhitvā cattāri sāmaññaphalāni gahetabbāni.
mil7.8.4:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja khettassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.4:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja khettaṃ uṭṭhānasampannaṃ hoti kassakassa hāsajanakaṃ, appam-pi bījaṃ vuttaṃ bahu hoti, bahu vuttaṃ bahutaraṃ hoti,
mil7.8.4:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena uṭṭhānasampannena vipulaphaladāyinā bhavitabbaṃ, dāyakānaṃ hāsajanakena bhavitabbaṃ, yathā appaṃ dinnaṃ bahu hoti, bahu dinnaṃ bahutaraṃ hoti.
mil7.8.4:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja khettassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.4:3.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Upālinā Vinayadharena:
